sources.title: The Institutional Origins of Miscalculation in China’s International Crises
sources.author: Tyler Jost
sources.source_type: Peer-reviewed scholarly article; new full reading of source previously selected as EP319
sources.read_scope: All narrative, acknowledgments and notes 1–191, printed pp. 47–90, read sequentially through complete overlapping publisher HTML/browser captures. Tables 1–2 and Figure 1 separately acquired and visually read in full. Main article PDF was not acquired. Citation checking is not full reading of every cited work.

artifact.role: Merged derived text retaining original browser line numbers; not a PDF facsimile

limitations: Security-crisis sample ends in 2012; Xi-era discussion is prospective/inferential.
Anonymous author interviews and underlying Chinese records are not independent project access.
The April 17 CIA information report cannot independently establish the timing or cause of the April 11 release decision.
The p. 83 settlement-letter attribution needs distinction from separate Powell–Qian authority correspondence now being independently investigated by the parent.

sources.title: Online Appendix: The Institutional Origins of Miscalculation in China’s International Crises
sources.author: Tyler Jost
sources.source_type: Author-hosted scholarly appendix; same PDF listed in replication metadata
sources.read_scope: Complete sections 1–2, printed pp. 1–13; complete section 3.1, pp. 13–15 before section 3.2; complete section 3.2.23 (EP-3), p. 41; complete sections 3.2.24–25 (Senkaku/Scarborough), pp. 42–43; complete sections 4–5, pp. 44–50. Text and all notes within these sections read. Tables 1–6 and Figure 1 visually inspected on pp. 4, 6–7, 46–47. Other case justifications not systematically read; incidental adjoining text is not represented as full reading.
limitations: The 1950–1989 meeting series is not a systematic record of Jiang or Xi deliberations.
Membership imputation and agenda inference are disclosed; attendance is not a direct measure of candor.
Official chronicle omissions and editorial choices remain an inferential limitation.
Small-sample personalism tests do not establish that personal power is causally irrelevant.

Original goals and underlying source judgments are not independently recoded.

sources.title: Appraisal of the Situation: Chinese Leadership Perspectives on the Effects of the 1 April Collision of a U.S. EP-3 Aircraft and a Chinese F-8-II Fighter
sources.author: Central Intelligence Agency; underlying source redacted
sources.date_of_information: Redacted; do not substitute distribution date for source information date
sources.FOIA_case_as_cited_by_Jost: F-2018-01240; not independently verified from a release cover letter
sources.source_type: Released CIA information report, explicitly not finally evaluated intelligence; archived copy of official public attachment
sources.read_scope: All surviving text and markings on both physical pages visually read, including paragraphs 1–3, report warning and visible redactions. Source/DOI and other redacted material unavailable. Browser OCR not relied upon for passages lost beneath markings.

access_metadata.role: Public CDX metadata identifying the successful archive capture

locators.source_status: p. 1 heading and warning; p. 2 repeated warning

limitations: The report describes likely recognition, not a named leader’s documented admission.
Source identity, date of information and basis of access are redacted.
The opening is after the April 12 crew release and forecasts April 18 negotiations; it does not date an information change before release authorization.
Claims about Jiang’s protective political strategy are the report’s interpretation, not independently observed Chinese deliberations.
Live attachment/landing URLs redirected to homepage; only the archived valid PDF was acquired.
sources.evidentiary_use: A contemporary but unevaluated account distinguishing likely private expectations from continued public demands; does not identify the cause of the crew-release decision.

scope_note: One complete article reading, one selected appendix reading, one complete small replication table inspection, and one complete reading of surviving text in a two-page released information report. These are not four independent confirmations of the same claim.
storage: Raw sources and derivatives preserved outside Git; article itself preserved as full publisher HTML extracts, not a valid PDF. Failed HTML/verification responses excluded from substantive source records. Shared ledger and chapters unchanged.
